name: Protected routes — unauthenticated user sees login gate

planSteps.description: Navigate to /book-rental without being logged in
The page does NOT show a property listing; instead it shows a 'Please Log In as Customer' message or an 'Enter Customer Portal' button
Navigate to /owner without being logged in
The page shows a 'Please Log In as Owner' message or an 'Enter Owner Portal' button, not the owner dashboard
Navigate to /admin without being logged in
The page shows a login gate or 'Please Log In as Admin' message
